Package chessgame.pieces

Class Knight

java.lang.Object
chessgame.pieces.Piece
chessgame.pieces.Knight
public class Knight extends Piece
Represents a Knight piece in the chess game. Extends the base Piece class and provides specific implementations for the Knight's algebraic letter and Unicode icons.

      public Knight(byte row, byte col, boolean isWhite)
      Constructs a Knight piece with the specified board coordinates and color. * @param row The initial row position on the board (0-7).
      Parameters:
      col - The initial column position on the board (0-7).
      isWhite - True if the piece belongs to the white player, false if black.

    • Knight

      public Knight(int row, int col, boolean isWhite)
      Constructs a Knight piece using integer coordinates and color. This is a convenience constructor that passes the integers to the superclass. * @param row The initial row position on the board (0-7).
      Parameters:
      col - The initial column position on the board (0-7).
      isWhite - True if the piece belongs to the white player, false if black.
